ui:title: StackGuardian Runner Group
ui:description: Create a new StackGuardian Runner Group with cloud storage backend (AWS S3 or Azure Blob Storage). Default tags are automatically applied: 'StackGuardian Private Runner', runner group name, and organization name.

api_key.ui:description: Your organization's API key (sgo_*/sgu_*) or a secret reference (${secret::SECRET_NAME})

org_name.ui:description: Your organization name. If not provided, will be extracted from environment.

cloud_provider.ui:description: Select the cloud provider for the storage backend

aws_region.ui:description: The target AWS Region for S3 bucket and IAM resources

azure_location.ui:description: The Azure region where storage resources will be deployed

create_azure_resource_group.ui:description: Create a new Azure Resource Group for the storage account (Azure only). Disable to deploy into an existing resource group.

create_blob_reader_role_assignment.ui:description: Grant the OIDC connector service principal 'Storage Blob Data Reader' on the storage account (Azure only). Disable when the identity running Terraform lacks role-assignment write permission; you must then create the assignment out of band.

azure_resource_group_name.ui:description: Optional name override when creating the resource group; required when using an existing resource group.

create_storage_backend.ui:description: Whether to create a new storage backend (S3 bucket for AWS, Storage Account for Azure)

existing_s3_bucket_name.ui:description: Name of an existing S3 bucket to use as storage backend (AWS only)

existing_azure_storage_account_name.ui:description: Name of an existing Azure Storage Account to use as storage backend (Azure only)

existing_azure_storage_account_access_ke.ui:description: Access key for the existing Azure Storage Account (Azure only)

force_destroy_storage_backend.ui:description: Warning: Force destroy the S3 bucket on module destruction (deletes all data, AWS only)

azure_storage.ui:title: Azure Storage Configuration
azure_storage.ui:description: Configure Azure Storage Account settings (Azure only)

account_tier.ui:description: Performance tier of the storage account

account_replication_type.ui:description: Replication strategy for the storage account

runner_group_name.ui:description: Override the runner group name. If empty, uses {effective_prefix}-runner-group-{account_id}

connector_name.ui:description: Override the connector name (AWS only). If empty, uses {effective_prefix}-private-runner-backend-{account_id}

max_runners.ui:description: Maximum number of runners allowed in the runner group
